fato_historico: 1997: Egon Krenz, the former East German leader, is convicted of a shoot-to-kill policy at the Berlin Wall.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle awakening of your adventurous spirit. Much like the collapse of old barriers once witnessed in history, you are encouraged to release any lingering restrictions in your heart. It is a good time to consider how far your wings can spread when you choose forgiveness and optimistic forward movement over holding onto the past.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when we let go of the walls we built within ourselves.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic journey toward personal wisdom and spiritual growth.
conselho: Trust your intuition and take one bold step toward your highest dreams today.
